headline: 412 customers were debited by HDFC Bank and their orders are on hold
cause: HDFC Bank has not confirmed these payments to Razorpay

heard.note: 9:31 pm, before any alert of yours

answer.title: HDFC Bank has not confirmed these payments
answer.text: Since 9:12 pm, payments from HDFC Bank accounts have stayed pending. The money left the customer's account, but the bank's confirmation never reached Razorpay, so no order was made. Razorpay and every other bank were working normally. Not yet compared with other merchants, so this is likely, not exact.

groups.label: Paid again
groups.hint: ₹1,38,891, charged twice if the bank confirms

compared: Compared with your payments in the same hours the day before
cannot_see: customers whose bank debited them but who closed the app before the pending screen

root.cause: HDFC Bank took the money but has not told Razorpay the payment went through, so each payment stays pending and no order is confirmed.
root.fix: Ask HDFC Bank to confirm or reverse the payments, and keep the orders on hold until it does.
signals: every payment has been pending since 9:12 pm
every one is an HDFC Bank account
other banks confirmed normally in the same minutes

actions.title: Ask HDFC Bank to confirm
actions.text: Prepares the 412 payment IDs with amounts and times (₹5,34,688 in all) for your payments team to send to HDFC Bank, to confirm or reverse.

actions.title: Refund 109 second payments
actions.text: ₹1,38,891 goes back to the customers who paid again by another method while HDFC was pending, so nobody is charged twice if the bank confirms the first.

actions.title: Message 412 customers
actions.text: Tells them the money has left their account, the order is on hold, and the bank has been asked to confirm. In your name. It waits until the list is ready for HDFC.

explained_from: from the first pending payment, with proof
closing: The cause was HDFC Bank, not your app or Razorpay. Every action is approved. In this demo nothing was sent to the bank or the customers.

rca.title: Root cause: HDFC Bank has not confirmed payments it debited
lines: Whose side: the bank. Confidence: likely, 3 signals agree. Not yet compared with other merchants.
Started: 9:12 pm. Razorpay and every other bank are working normally.
Affected: 412 customers debited, 303 orders on hold and 109 who paid again.
Fix: ask HDFC Bank to confirm or reverse. Refund the second payments now.
rca.signed_off: Signed off by Razorpay support at 9:38 pm
